scope: K01: report XPST0051 for invalid list SequenceType item names at executed legacy typed bindings; independently verify the already-passing castable case
sections: 2.5.5.2 Matching an ItemType and an Item
requiredBehavior: A SequenceType EQName must resolve to a generalized atomic type; a named list type is invalid and raises XPST0051. A list constructor/cast may instead return a sequence of member atomic values; castable to xs:NMTOKENS remains valid.
intentionalBoundaries: Use the existing illegal function-conversion target validator before legacy EnforceType atomization/cardinality checks.
This correction does not establish a complete static-error detection mode or change all schema/type resolution paths.
No XPath4 draft adoption, generic list item type, schema-loader expansion or fixture assertion change.
Keep both existing skip entries and exact frozen baseline totals until explicit approval of a concrete baseline-policy update.
